name: lt-open-data
description: Agent skills for Lithuanian Open Data (OKF v0.3): discover Spinta DSA schemas and EU/ISO classifications, query get.data.gov.lt RQL endpoints with provenance/trust/attestation reporting, and steward or validate OKF v0.3 bundles.

interface.shortDescription: Query and steward Lithuanian Open Data OKF v0.3 bundles
interface.longDescription: Use lt-open-data to discover Spinta DSA schemas and EU/ISO classifications, construct get.data.gov.lt RQL queries, execute attested statutory computations, and report OKF v0.3 trust, freshness, and citations. Use lt-open-data-steward to refresh, enrich, verify, deprecate, migrate, or validate Lithuanian Open Data OKF v0.3 bundles.
defaultPrompt: Find open datasets on get.data.gov.lt about legal entity tax payments and build a bounded RQL query.
Convert a historical LTL amount to EUR using the bundle's Attested Computation and report trust and attestation.
Validate the Lithuanian Open Data OKF v0.3 bundle with strict and Spinta checks.
